name: Rule 6 status planning appeal/called-in application
fact: Updated 18 March 2026; substantive interested parties can seek Rule 6 status in an inquiry.
gate: Rule 6 status is procedural participation, not a merits decision.

name: Planning appeals inquiry guidance collection
fact: The collection includes current 2026 taking-part guidance for planning appeals dealt with by inquiry.
gate: Inquiry procedure does not imply likely outcome or parcel value.

name: Planning Practice Guidance appeals
fact: Revised 2 April 2026; PPG sets appeal time limits, procedures and 2027 performance targets and explains there is generally no third-party appeal against permission granted to someone else.
gate: Targets and rights are process rules, not a case-specific status or probability.

name: BR00191 5 Blackbird Hill
fact: The 2026 authoritative Brent record lists 57 dwellings, pending-decision status and notes application 20/2096 pending S106 plus Local Plan allocation BESA3.
gate: Pending decision and allocation are not permission; current application/S106 state must be rechecked.

name: BR35 Preston
fact: The 2026 Preston record notes outline application 06/2023/0731 for up to 108 residential apartments with access, appearance, scale and layout sought.
gate: An application description is not a granted permission; current decision and reserved matters must be verified.

name: BR20 Preston historical unavailable
fact: The Preston record has end date 3 December 2024 and notes various permissions were not implemented and the site is no longer considered available and achievable.
gate: Explicit end-date/unavailability makes this historical evidence; reject from current promotion.

name: BR01 Sharoe Green Hospital
fact: The Preston record has entry date 11 February 2026 but end date 23 February 2026; notes describe historic construction, 32 completions, a long stall and reduced site extent.
gate: End-dated/stalled historic evidence cannot be promoted as current remaining capacity without a newer authoritative record.

name: BR10 Lancashire House
fact: The Preston record is permissioned and notes active construction, but carries end date 3 December 2024.
gate: End-dated construction evidence is historical and excluded from current capacity without superseding data.

name: BR27 Egerton Road
fact: The 2026 Preston record covers 0.5ha, records up to 20 dwellings and states 'No pp.' with not-permissioned status.
gate: Historic allocation/reference and dwelling range are not planning permission.

name: BR85 Queen Street Manchester Road
fact: The 2026 Preston record lists outline permission 06/2022/1084 for 469 residential apartments and permissioned status.
gate: Outline permission still requires exact live permission, conditions/reserved matters, commencement and remaining-capacity checks.

name: BR19 Miller Arcade
fact: The 2026 Preston record notes a historic conversion permission for 45 studios and a valid 2026 application 06/2026/0150.
gate: A newer live application can change the development state; do not rely on the older permission alone.

name: BR00061 Kenton Road
fact: The authoritative Brent record has 2026 entry date, 2.45ha, up to 150 dwellings and Local Plan allocation BNWSA1.
gate: Allocation and headline dwelling capacity are not consent or remaining deliverable capacity.

name: BR00149 Park Lane
fact: The Brent record has 10 March 2026 entry date, 0.03ha, 3 dwellings and notes part of the site is residential garden and not PDL.
gate: Brownfield-register inclusion does not mean every part of the geometry is previously developed land.

name: BR00005 Brent public site
fact: The 2026 Brent record is public-owned, lists 67 dwellings and full planning permission dated 24 June 2019.
gate: Public ownership plus historic permission still requires commencement/completion and current land-control checks.

name: BR00185 Former Malcolm House
fact: The 2026 Brent record lists 100 dwellings, not-permissioned status and Local Plan allocation BCSA13.
gate: Allocation is not consent; current application, availability and exact geometry remain required.

name: BR00264 Preston Road Harrow
fact: The 2026 Brent record lists 8 dwellings, full permission dated 17 December 2021 and permissioned status.
gate: A permissioned register entry is not proof of unbuilt remaining capacity; commencement/completion must be checked.

name: 214 KCC Depot Broad Lane
fact: The authoritative Dartford record has 2025 entry date, 6-9 dwellings, public ownership, not-permissioned status and notes pending consideration of 25/00121/FUL.
gate: A pending application note must not be treated as permission or current decision without live register verification.
